reason: A DSH compatibility workaround that prevents redundant same-mode sandbox escalation requests from being rejected before supported tool calls execute.

summaries.zh: 这是一个为 DeepSeek Harness 提供兼容处理的插件，用于移除非升级沙箱请求中的冗余字段，避免 bash、pwsh、write 和 edit 调用被错误拒绝。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness compatibility plugin that removes redundant fields from non-escalating sandbox requests so supported bash, pwsh, write, and edit calls are not incorrectly rejected.

capabilities: Wraps DSH tool execution and agent-loop preparation methods
Removes redundant sandbox_permissions and justification fields for bash, pwsh, write, and edit calls when the requested mode is not wider than the session mode
Leaves genuinely wider, malformed, unrelated, and field-free calls unchanged
Restores the original runtime methods when disposed
